screen.plume_summoner.title: Plume Summoner
tooltip.plume_summoner.locked: Kill this mob to unlock its summon.
message.plume_summoner.not_unlocked: This mob is not unlocked yet.
plume_summoner.configuration.title: Plume Summoner Configuration
plume_summoner.configuration.killsToUnlo: How many kills are required to unlock a mob for summoning.
plume_summoner.configuration.maxSummonCo: Maximum number of mobs summonable in a single request, default 50. The server clamps the count to this value even if the client requests more (prevents entity flooding).
plume_summoner.configuration.blacklist.t: Entities hidden from the summon menu, one per entry, format: modid:entityid (e.g. minecraft:zombie). Use "all" to hide every entity (entities explicitly listed in the whitelist are then shown as exceptions). Invalid entries are ignored.
plume_summoner.configuration.whitelist.t: Entities shown in the summon menu, one per entry, format: modid:entityid (e.g. minecraft:zombie). Defaults to "all" (every entity visible). The blacklist takes priority: entries in the blacklist are subtracted from the whitelist result.
